scope: Sargent and Stachurski, Dynamic Programming, Volume 2 (General States), Chapter 2: Abstract Decision Processes. Order stability and its duality, chain and countable Dedekind completeness, Knaster-Tarski by Zorn's lemma, order continuity and Tarski-Kantorovich; abstract dynamic programs on posets with greedy policies, the Bellman operator, V_G, V_U and V_Sigma, the fundamental optimality properties (Lemmas 2.1.1-2.1.3, Proposition 2.1.4, Theorems 2.1.5 and 2.1.7, Corollary 2.1.6); VFI, OPI and HPI for every greedy selector (Lemmas 2.2.1-2.2.4, Corollary 2.2.5, Theorems 2.2.6-2.2.8); minimization by the dual ADP (Theorem 2.2.9, Corollary 2.2.10); applications: firm valuation, optimal savings and finite MDPs as ADPs (Proposition 2.3.1), LQ control (Lemmas 2.3.3, 2.3.5-2.3.9, the Riccati equation) and distributional dynamic programming (Proposition 2.3.2, the Wasserstein contraction); with the provable exercises, and the Chapter 1 models and Volume 1 spectral-radius facts restated.
source: Thomas J. Sargent and John Stachurski, Dynamic Programming, Volume 2: General States, Chapter 2, pp. 58-97, with the Appendix A results used there.
